passage.quote: The command-line interface lets agents, scripts, and people read the same project and prepare changes for acceptance. It exposes descriptions, source, link validation, impact analysis, and recorded checks, and can direct the desktop to a description being discussed.

summary: The CLI exposes project descriptions, source, structural validation, impact, and recorded check evidence.
Preparation and explicit acceptance identify an exact proposal; the caller supplies semantic judgment and runs checks with existing tools.
UI current and UI open coordinate the reader’s focus without granting edit or commit authority.
The installed command launches the bundled desktop without a build; help and executable identity work outside a repository.
